claim.value: France was the mandatory power administering French Togoland under the League of Nations mandate

scope.description: Named historical administration or royal polity; no geometry-derived sovereignty or modern-country backprojection.

evidence.locator: Mandat français sur le Togo, Acte de Londres 20 July1922, Articles2–12
evidence.note: Mandate legal powers and reporting duties name France. The mandate is not annexation, and British Togoland is not included.

qualifications: Mandate administration distinguished from sovereignty and the later United Nations trusteeship. Existing entity bounds end before1946.

origin.reference: Regional Batch 15 French West African original institutional source packet
